authorization.acceptedAction: Record the supplied interactive Claude approval with provenance and conclude this exchange using the existing aggregator, without an additional CLI review.
authorization.scope: Review-record import only; no code change, reviewer execution, preflight bypass, provider call, production approval, push or deployment is authorized.

importProvenance.reviewerExecution: Not executed or authenticated by this import or by the cross-review control program. command, preflight, usage, duration and sandbox/auth fields remain as supplied, including nulls.
importProvenance.timestampInterpretation: startedAt and receivedAt are timestamps reported in the supplied candidate, not importer-observed session events. The candidate marks startedAt approximate and describes receivedAt as verdict finalisation; neither timestamp is independently verified. importedAt is the local import/replay observation time.
importProvenance.observationBoundary: The reviewer notes' direct-test, read-only-worktree and interactive-session statements are supplied reviewer claims. This importer directly checked attachment-copy bytes/hashes, verdict consistency, source/package digest identity and pure replay derivation; it did not rerun the claimed reviewer checks or observe their sandbox.
importProvenance.integrityBoundary: SHA-256 records byte identity of the supplied artifacts, not reviewer identity, a digital signature, human inspection or authenticated execution.
importProvenance.approvalBoundary: The supplied approve verdict applies only to its named source digest. replayExchange derives passed from the supplied verdict and existing package checks; it does not authenticate this external provenance or authorize production use.
